references.text: This verse contains the original message to love your neighbor as yourself, which Jesus refers to as part of the new commandment.
Jesus repeats and expands on the message of mutual love, defining the highest form of love as laying down one's life for friends.
The author emphasizes that God's command is to believe in the name of Jesus and love one another, just as he has commanded us.
The text links love directly to God's nature and our mutual love as proof that we are born of God.
Paul describes the essence and actions of love, which is the practical outworking of the command to love one another.
Here the whole law is summed up in one command: to love your neighbor as yourself, which is the core of Jesus' new commandment.
